title: Anth.us: tag collections, listings and tag pages on core listings (phase c)
description: Phase c of PPY-e329c3, not done. Core's pagination already equals Anth.us's (featured 4, then pages of 8: standard/projector.py _paginate equals anthus_pages.collection_slices). Missing is selection: Anth.us collections are tag-defined, not CMS sections. /articles/ = published items except tags solutions and posts (plus a hidden drafts block on page 1), /posts/ = tag posts, /reading/ and /research/ = single pages by tag, 40 tag pages and the /tags/ index, each with its own hero, card grid and pager markup. Needed in core: collections selected by tag (include and exclude), per collection base, pageSize, featuredCount and sort, and the page_body hook for kinds listing, tag and tags. Then the card, hero and pager markup moves into hooks.py and anthus_pages.collection_*, tag_pages and Collections go. Depends on the base-class task. Gate: every listing and tag URL DOM-identical.
